spec.text: Image 1 is the man's character model sheet; image 2 is the woman's character model sheet; image 3 is the bridge and river for this scene; image 4 is the approved art style (sculpted matte clay figurines placed in a painted storybook set). Morning, inside a city bus crossing the cable-stayed bridge from image 3. The woman sits by the window; just outside, another bus passes in the opposite direction and through its window the man looks back at her, their eyes meeting. The wide river and riverside bike paths below, the single bridge pylon and cables visible. Every character must be rendered as a dimensional sculpted matte clay figurine exactly like the people in the art-style image, about four heads tall, adult, with faces, glasses, hairstyles and outfits identical to their references, never as a flat 2D drawing. Mouths closed in small gentle smiles. Recreate any real place from the photos in the same warm matte clay and gouache storybook style. Cinematic composition. Any signs, plaques, screens or documents are blank; no readable text. No photorealism, no glossy plastic.
